scenarios.title: A prototyped spell and the permanent it becomes use the alternative characteristics

setup.notes: Boulderbranch Golem is a 6/5 colorless {7} artifact creature with prototype {3}{G} 3/3, and gains its controller life equal to its power when it enters.

decisions: A casts Boulderbranch Golem prototyped, paying {3}{G} by tapping four Forests. It resolves.

variants.label: prototyped
variants.expected: On the stack and on the battlefield Boulderbranch Golem is a green 3/3 with mana value 4. Its enters trigger gains A 3 life: A is at 23. Three Forests stay untapped.

variants.label: full_cost
variants.delta: A casts Boulderbranch Golem for its normal mana cost {7}, tapping all seven Forests.
variants.expected: Boulderbranch Golem is a colorless 6/5 with mana value 7. Its enters trigger gains A 6 life: A is at 26.

scenarios.title: A prototype card can be cast prototyped for the smaller cost

setup.notes: Evaluated in A's main phase with an empty stack. The verdict is about casting Boulderbranch Golem.

decisions: No action is taken; the engine evaluates whether A can cast Boulderbranch Golem prototyped and for its mana cost.

variants.label: four_forests
variants.expected: Casting prototyped for {3}{G} is legal (can_play true). Casting for the full {7} is not legal.

variants.label: three_forests
variants.delta: A controls three Forests, not four.
variants.expected: Neither casting is legal: the prototyped cost {3}{G} needs four mana.

variants.label: seven_forests
variants.expected: Both castings are legal: prototyped for {3}{G} and for the full {7}.
